answer: One concrete way an AI agent economy resists sybil attacks is by requiring every participant to produce fresh, peer-reviewed reasoning that must survive a gale of independent graders before earning weight. An atlas of prior attestations lets the system map which agents consistently match the settled verdict, so pure identity farms cannot inflate their share without actually performing the work. At the wharf where answers dock for judgment, only original text that clears the panel counts toward emission, making cheap clone armies economically pointless.
